name: Gakuen Senki
source:
Hero is student council president and everyday he solves requests from students. With each new request he approaches the secret behind this school. 

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是学生会长，每天负责处理学生们的请求。随着解决一个又一个请求，他逐渐接近这所学校隐藏的秘密。

[译自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
